title: Have a licensed nominee to offer electrical services
what: Offer electrical services as a corporation only with a nominee licensed in the electrician occupation for the service.

sources.title: Construction Occupations (Licensing) Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 82(1) (current republication (R72, from 10 November 2026; Construction Occupations (Licensing) Act 2004 | Acts))
sources.quote: A corporation commits an offence if the corporation— (a) advertises or otherwise offers to provide a service in a construction occupation or occupation class; and (b) does not have a nominee who has a licence that authorises the nominee to provide the service
